name: Claude Sonnet 4
strengths: Excellent at analysis, coding, and following complex instructions. Very strong at long-context tasks.
weaknesses: Not as fast as smaller models. Can be overly cautious.
best_for: Complex analysis, code generation, document review

name: Claude Haiku 3.5
strengths: Fast, cheap, surprisingly capable for its size. Great for high-volume tasks.
weaknesses: Less capable on complex reasoning than Sonnet/Opus.

name: GPT-4o
strengths: Strong multimodal (text, image, audio). Fast. Good general-purpose model.
weaknesses: Can be verbose. Sometimes overconfident on uncertain answers.
best_for: General chat, multimodal tasks, function calling

name: GPT-4o Mini
strengths: Very cheap, fast, good for simple tasks. Supports function calling.
weaknesses: Struggles with complex reasoning and nuance.

name: Gemini 1.5 Pro
strengths: Massive 1M context window. Good at long document analysis. Native multimodal.
weaknesses: Can be inconsistent. Sometimes misses nuances in complex prompts.
best_for: Long document analysis, video understanding, large codebases

name: Gemini 2.0 Flash
strengths: Extremely cheap, fast, good quality for the price. 1M context.
weaknesses: Less capable than Pro models on complex tasks.

name: Llama 3.1 70B
strengths: Open source. Strong coding and reasoning. Can run locally.
weaknesses: Requires significant compute to self-host. Less polished than proprietary models.

name: Mistral Large
strengths: Strong European alternative. Good at multilingual tasks. Fast.
best_for: Multilingual tasks, European data compliance, function calling

name: DeepSeek V3
strengths: Extremely cheap for its capability level. Strong at coding and math.
weaknesses: Newer provider, less enterprise support. Privacy concerns for some users.
best_for: Budget-conscious coding, math tasks, high-volume processing

name: Groq Llama 3 70B
strengths: Fastest inference available (LPU hardware). Great for real-time applications.
weaknesses: Smaller context window. Limited model selection.
best_for: Real-time chat, low-latency applications, rapid prototyping

name: Claude Opus 4
strengths: Most capable model for complex reasoning, research, and creative tasks.
weaknesses: Expensive. Slower than Sonnet. Overkill for simple tasks.
best_for: Research, complex analysis, creative writing, hardest coding tasks

name: GPT-4o Turbo
strengths: JSON mode, function calling, vision. Strong all-around.
best_for: Structured output, complex function calling, vision tasks

name: Cohere Command R+
strengths: Excellent RAG capabilities. Built-in citation. Strong at enterprise search.
weaknesses: Less creative than competitors. Narrower use case.
best_for: RAG applications, enterprise search, document Q&A with citations

name: Qwen 2.5 72B
strengths: Strong multilingual (especially CJK). Good coding. Open source.
weaknesses: Less known in Western markets. Smaller English community.
best_for: Multilingual applications, CJK languages, self-hosted deployments
